channel.title: Anthropic Blogcast
channel.description: Anthropic Blogcast turns Anthropic's latest announcements and research posts into listenable episodes — follow the Anthropic blog without reading. Hosted by Alex and Jordan. New episodes whenever Anthropic publishes.
channel.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi
channel.itunes:summary: Anthropic Blogcast turns Anthropic's latest announcements and research posts into listenable episodes — follow the Anthropic blog without reading. Hosted by Alex and Jordan. New episodes whenever Anthropic publishes.

item.title: Episode 1: Claude Sonnet 5.5: The Mid-Tier Just Got Scary Good
item.description: Anthropic's new mid-tier model is scarily good: Alex and Jordan break down Claude Sonnet 5.5's coding chops, its 1M-token context on every tier, and why Epic Games and Rakuten are betting big on it.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 2: Barclays Goes All In on Claude
item.description: Alex and Jordan unpack Barclays' bank-wide Claude rollout: Claude Code for engineers, a million-search knowledge assistant, and 120,000 emails a day.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 3: Building with Claude Sonnet 5.5
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down Anthropic's developer guide to Claude Sonnet 5.5: pricing, model details, migration breaking changes, and tuning tips.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 4: Automating Eval Design and Hillclimbing with Claude
item.description: Alex and Jordan unpack Anthropic's guide to building evaluations and improving against them with the claude-api skill's build-eval and hillclimb commands.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi
